title: Story premise EDU063: The Drawer That Counts Footprints
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (home organization). Hook: Are these shirts too many, or just packed differently? Takeaway/theme: Consistent dimensions can make storage capacity and visibility easier to reason about.
description: A dresser wants six folded shirts to fit without hiding the bottom ones, but each fold uses a different footprint. A measured toy folding template makes the available drawer layout visible before packing.
